title: Sky mark wipe into version dive
summary: A frosted mark settles over drifting sky footage, slides aside to wipe on the product name with its version, the sky washes to white and a huge thin version number holds, then the camera dives into it.
use_when: Announcing a major version of an existing product (2.0, v3) in a vertical feed
A short silent brand sting before a longer release film
The brand has a compact mark and an airy, light identity
You have one calm background clip (sky, water, texture) and no UI to show

look.type_style: label: medium rounded grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, ~2.6 % H, white then dark grey; version numeral: thin (~200 weight) rounded grotesk, ~10 % H centred, light grey to near-black

sfx.event: mark slides aside and wipes on the label

structure.shot: blue sky with cumulus clouds (footage); the brand mark appears large and frosted at upper centre and settles to solid white
structure.camera: footage drift: slow push 1.00 to ~1.02 across the row, clouds stay framed
structure.motion: mark in at f1: scale ~1.5 -> 1.0 and opacity 0.35 -> 1, easings.outExpo 17 fr (f1-f18), no overshoot; frame 0 is empty sky

structure.shot: solid white mark, ~18 % of frame width, centred at 40 % H over the sky; nothing else
structure.camera: footage drift continues, mark fixed in frame

structure.shot: the mark slides right and folds away while the label (product name plus version, 3 words) is uncovered left to right behind it
structure.camera: footage drift, mark and label locked to the frame
structure.motion: label uncovered left to right by the mark's trailing edge (mask-wipe), easings.inOutCubic 10 fr (f86-f96); the mark keeps sliding right and folds to a thin sliver, gone by f104

structure.shot: the label alone over the sky; its colour drifts from white to dark grey while the sky washes out toward white
structure.motion: label white until f107, fades out over 6 fr (f108-f113) and returns dark grey #555555 over f114-f119 (light-wash); footage lifts to white over f120-f126

structure.shot: plain white canvas, the version numeral alone, huge and thin, centred
structure.camera: static until f150, then a slight creep 1.00 -> 1.03 to f162
structure.motion: cut-through-white at f127 to the numeral, which resolves light grey -> near-black in 13 fr (f127-f140), easings.outCubic; holds 22 fr

structure.shot: the camera dives into the numeral, the final zero swelling past the frame edges; film ends mid-dive
structure.camera: zoom-through toward the right part of the numeral, scale 1.03 -> ~2.6 over 13 fr (f162-f174), easings.inExpo
structure.motion: accelerating zoom only; last frame (f174) still mid-move, no settle

params.brand: any brand.json with a compact mark; mark is drawn in white over the clip, label and numeral use the display font
params.content.footage: one calm, bright background clip (sky, clouds, water), at least 4.2 s
params.content.label: product name plus version, 2-3 words, one line
params.content.version: version numeral shown huge at the end, e.g. '2.0'
params.timing.markHold: frames the mark holds before the wipe (default 54)
params.timing.numberHold: frames the numeral holds before the dive (default 24)
params.aspect: 9:16 first; 1:1 and 16:9 keep the centred mark and numeral
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Frames measured from 30 fps strips of the local source (not copied). Proposed terms, not in vocabulary and not used as ids: mark-fold-wipe (row 3), frost-settle (row 1), light-wash (row 4). The row-4 transition is a fast wash/crossfade through white (f120-f127) with no blur visible; blur-dissolve is the nearest vocabulary id. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured: the reference is silent. The film ends mid-zoom; for a loop or a longer film, put the next scene behind the ZoomThrough. Background footage is a user input with no schema field (see params.content.footage).
